decisions.decision: Concrete filled bollards with eye bolts (no chain) will be installed at gate locations along the fire lane, with 'Authorized Vehicles Only' signage; chains can be added later if enforcement is a problem.
decisions.quote: concrete filled bollards with eye bolts (no chain) will be installed at gate locations

decisions.decision: The driveway between the Passios parking lot and the auto loop will be widened from 24 ft to 26 ft to remove a safety bottleneck.
decisions.quote: the driveway will be widened from 24' to 26' within the short section between passios parking lot and the auto loop

decisions.decision: Snow will be stored on lawn areas adjacent to parking lots.
decisions.quote: areas of lawn adjacent to parking lots would be the location for storage of snow

decisions.decision: Exterior lighting will be LED; no objections were raised; the existing pole light near the MA Ave entrance may be adequate without an added street light.
decisions.quote: it was noted that exterior lighting would be led type

decisions.decision: Desired speed tables in the access drive were confirmed as desirable.
decisions.quote: desire for speed tables in access drive were confirmed as desirable.

decisions.decision: At existing transite pipes, slip lining with new piping is preferred over total replacement (new valves required).
decisions.quote: at existing transite pipes, slip lining with new piping is preferred vs. total replacement.

decisions.decision: Fire department hose connection valves in egress stairs will be provided at floor landings rather than intermediate landings.
decisions.quote: fire department hose connection valves in egress stairs to be provided at floor landings

decisions.decision: A post indicator valve on the exterior fire protection service will not be required.
decisions.quote: a post indicator valve on exterior fire protection service will not be required.

decisions.decision: Separate knox boxes will be mounted at entrances, one blue and one red at each location, as requested by Police and Fire.
decisions.quote: police and fire requested separate knox boxes mounted at entrances, one blue and one red at each location.

decisions.decision: Sprinkler system zoning of 4 zones (High School, Middle School, Auditorium and Gymnasium) was presented; attendees had no objections.
decisions.quote: sprinkler system zoning of 4 zones (high school, middle school, auditorium and gymnasium) was presented. attendees had no objections.

decisions.decision: Emergency generator will be diesel; agreed as acceptable.
decisions.quote: emergency generator is to be diesel, it was agreed that this is acceptable.

decisions.decision: Faraday will not be included as a manufacturer for the fire alarm system, per the facilities director.
decisions.quote: do not include faraday as a manufacturer for fire alarm system per facilities director.

decisions.decision: Remote drill switch not required; integral with the Fire Alarm Control Panel is acceptable.
decisions.quote: remote drill switch not required, integral with fire alarm control panel is acceptable.

decisions.decision: Stopper covers on manual pull stations are not required, per the facilities director; Fire Department took no exceptions.
decisions.quote: stoppers covers on manual pull stations are not required per facilities director, fire department took no exceptions.

decisions.decision: Kitchen exhaust fan may be on standby power, with TMP to verify the load; lavatories are hard wired and will be on standby power.
decisions.quote: kitchen exhaust fan: possibly on standby power, tmp to verify load.

decisions.decision: Additional security cameras in gymnasium and cafeteria will be provided; TMP will review all camera locations and types to potentially reduce quantities.
decisions.quote: additional security cameras in gymnasium and cafeteria will be provided.

decisions.decision: A separate meeting will be held with public safety and the school department on details of the school's security design.
decisions.quote: it was noted that a separate meeting would be held with public safety and the school

decisions.decision: Parking and pedestrian lighting pole heights are not restricted; heights similar to Turkey Hill Middle School (about 20'-25') to be used.
decisions.quote: no pole height restrictions, use pole heights similar to

decisions.decision: Sports lighting for basketball and tennis courts is not required.
decisions.quote: sports lighting for basketball and tennis courts not required.

decisions.decision: A new football field will be provided with lighting and a sound system.
decisions.quote: new football field to be provided with lighting and sound system.

decisions.decision: A new pressbox will be provided with an accessible lift.
decisions.quote: new pressbox will be provided with an accessible lift.

decisions.decision: The pump house off Oak Ave. will be demolished.
decisions.quote: pump house off of oak ave. to be demolished.

decisions.decision: Temporary feed to be provided for existing sports lighting and concession stand fed from Oak Ave.
decisions.quote: existing sports lighting and concession stand fed from oak ave. temporary feed to be provided.

decisions.decision: Conduit provisions to be provided for future power at gates for road access behind the building.
decisions.quote: conduit provisions to be provided for future power at gates for road access behind

decisions.decision: TMP to provide power for school signage at the Mass Ave and Oak Ave entrances; a possible third location at the new high school main entrance is to be considered.
decisions.quote: tmp to provide power for school signage located at mass ave entrance and oak ave

decisions.decision: Police Department has no proprietary manufacturer/systems.
decisions.quote: police department has no proprietary manufacturer/systems.

decisions.decision: Fire Department Captain will verify with the Chief the potential for a second exterior fire alarm beacon.
decisions.quote: fire department captain will verify with chief the potential for a second exterior fire

decisions.decision: Architect recommended low energy fire alarm wiring over armored cable if it is a cost savings; type of wiring to be reviewed.
decisions.quote: architect recommended option of low energy if it is a cost savings.

decisions.decision: Zoning Enforcement Officer's understanding is that the educational facility is exempt from Zoning By-Law conformance and no variances are required; he will confirm with Town legal counsel.
decisions.quote: zoning enforcement officer confirmed that his understanding is that this educational facility is exempt

decisions.decision: Development Plan Review is required with the Planning Board (no formal hearing or public notice); the board will expedite the project when submitted; 7 copies of drawings required.
decisions.quote: planning confirmed that development plan review is required with the planning board
